name: Temazepam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: Temazepam's brand name is Restoril. It is a hypnotic benzodiazepine with effects similar to clonazepam. The drug is frequently prescribed as a sleep aid. There are some anectodal reports that indicate it has mild euphoria alongside the hypnotic effects.

tolerance.buildUp: within a couple of days of continuous use
